scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w client & wait
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify:pwa: npm run build -w client && node scripts/verify-tabbar-safe-area.mjs && node scripts/verify-pwa-autoupdate.mjs
scripts.verify:ui: npm run build -w client && node scripts/verify-pinned-headers.mjs && node scripts/verify-empty-exercise-card.mjs
